In some emails on Exchange (EWS) accounts, Thunderbird may hide the {button Reply All} button in the message header and the '''Recipients''' column may not display all recipient information when using Table View — even when multiple recipients are in the ''To'' or ''Cc'' fields. This article explains why this happens and how to fix the affected messages.

{note}'''Note:''' Only '''Thunderbird 152.0''' is affected and only for Microsoft Exchange accounts that use Exchange Web Services (EWS). IMAP and POP accounts are not affected, nor Thunderbird 151 or earlier. The underlying problem is corrected in '''Thunderbird 153'''.{/note}

== Why the Reply All button is missing ==

When Thunderbird 152.0 downloaded certain messages from an Exchange (EWS) server, some message details were not stored correctly in your local copy, including the full list of recipients. Because Thunderbird does not find more than one recipient, it does not show the {button Reply All} button for those messages or display the correct information in the Recipients column.

Whether a message is affected, depends on the version of Thunderbird that originally downloaded it, which is why only some messages are missing the button and others are not.

Updating to Thunderbird 153 avoids the problem, but messages that were already downloaded with incomplete data need to be repaired manually using the steps below.

== Repair an affected folder ==

You must update to version 152.0.1 or newer, then repair the folder to rebuild its local index with the missing recipient information. After a repair, the {button Reply All} button appears again for all messages that have multiple recipients, and the full recipient list shows correctly in the message list.

# Update to version 152.0.1 or newer. Briefly: click the Thunderbird app menu {menu ☰} > {menu Help} > {menu About Thunderbird}. If there is an update available, you will see the update download. When the download is finished,  click on {button Restart Thunderbird to Update} to update. Refer to [[Update Thunderbird to the latest version]].
# In the folder pane, find the Exchange (EWS) folder that contains messages with a missing {button Reply All} button.
# Right-click (control+click on macOS) the EWS folder > {menu Properties}.
# In the '''Folder Properties''' window, '''General information''' tab, click {button Repair Folder} and wait for the repair to finish.

Repeat these steps for other Exchange folders where the {button Reply All} button is missing.

== Still missing the Reply All button? ==

If the {button Reply All} button is still missing after updating Thunderbird and repairing the folder, confirm that the message actually has more than one recipient in the ''To'' or ''Cc'' fields. A message sent only to you will not show a {button Reply All} button.
